files.adaptation: Inject game context in constructor; use Three WebGL entry and local Events/maths imports. Vehicle constants and pre/post-physics algorithms retained.
Port chassis descriptors, mass/inertia, damping, friction and collision groups; enable chassis CCD; scale Boom world by 2 into original Motri units.

Port keyboard/gamepad steering and cubic touch throttle, 270-degree forward cone and reverse steering; retain Boom touch pad and independent firing pointer. Space and number keys remain combat controls.
Map chassis orientation and actual suspension lengths to existing normalized GLBs. Wheel rolling uses distance/radius and fixed time step. Preserve auto-righting delay.

legacy: Hajwala files remain only for the opt-in legacy model compatibility verifier. They are not imported by the live game.
